items.title: Proper base change holds for finite morphisms
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma records that cohomology commutes with base change for finite morphisms (statement lines 18518-18525). The proof (proof lines 18527-18536) uses that finite morphisms are proper with finite base changes, and combines the injective form of base change with the vanishing of the higher direct images of a finite morphism. H2: two inputs plus one criterion. The statement carries the author's slogan environment, delivered verbatim.
